vibe_and_atmosphere: Clean, transparent, organized, and motivating. Refreshing like nature, avoiding a sterile or chaotic look. Goal is to inspire trust and simplify recycling actions.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing scale. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Cards must have sufficient internal padding to prevent collision.
layouts.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 for the Home Page 4 sections
layouts.radius: rounded-2xl for primary cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for pills/buttons to maintain soft nature-inspired edges

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for clean subtle elevation, shadow-md on hover. Minimalist approach. Avoid heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#2C3E50]/10 for sticky headers

components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary CTA uses #2E5A44 background with white text. High-priority uses #E67E22. Hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-md.
components_instructions.cards: Soft-edged rounded containers (rounded-2xl). White background (#FFFFFF) with 1px border or subtle shadow-sm. Avoid visual overload.
components_instructions.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use soft organic colors (#2E5A44, #2980B9, #E67E22). Use Progress rings for recycling goals.
components_instructions.maps: Minimalist interactive maps. Strip out heavy default labels if possible. Soft rounded edges for the map container.
components_instructions.navigation: Persistent left-hand sidebar for Dashboard/Admin views. Top Nav for Main Landing Page. Active states highlighted in primary green (#2E5A44).
components_instructions.toasts: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., Missed collection alerts in Alert Red #C0392B)

motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 on cards and buttons, text color shift on hover.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets, lists, and articles.

images.description: Clean modern city street used for main landing page hero section.
Red, yellow, green recycling bins for educational dashboard articles.
Friendly customer support agent for the help center / AI chatbot avatar.

media.icons: lucide-react for clean, consistent dashboard iconography. Avoid overly complex icons.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Use specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Left-align dense content.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with hover states.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters.
Prioritize Shadcn/UI for tables, selects, dropdowns, dialogs.
Use Recharts/Shadcn for progress rings and volume charts.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #F8F9FA background passes with #2C3E50 text. Use white text over #2E5A44 buttons.
